party.emptyBody: Add a character to start drawing.

character.resetDeck: Reset deck to start of scenario

draw.tempBody: Scenario and item effects sometimes add plain modifier cards to your deck. They go to the discard and shuffle back in like normal cards, and stay in the deck until you remove them here or reset the deck.
draw.missEffects: MISS: no damage, but added effects still apply

settings.languageSub: Game text (perks, conditions) stays in English in this version
settings.unlockedStatus: {{unlocked}} of {{total}} unlockable classes revealed. Unlockable classes are hidden by their code name on the character picker until you tap to reveal them.
settings.relockBody: All unlockable classes will be hidden behind their code names again. Existing characters are unaffected.
settings.revealBody: This spoils the names of every unlockable Gloomhaven, Frosthaven, and fan-expansion class. Only do this if you don't mind seeing them.
settings.aboutBody: Attack Deck is a free, unofficial fan-made companion app for Gloomhaven, Frosthaven, Jaws of the Lion, and community fan expansions including The Crimson Scales and CCUG custom classes. Gloomhaven and Frosthaven are trademarks of Cephalofair Games. The Crimson Scales is a fan project by Bas Hoogeboom and contributors; CCUG classes are individually authored by community members. This app is not affiliated with Cephalofair or any fan-expansion authors.
settings.gameDataBody: {{count}} classes bundled. Perk data adapted from Gloomhaven Secretariat (github.com/Lurkars/gloomhavensecretariat), itself a community fork of Gloomhaven Helper. Some Frosthaven class-specific perk effects are summarised as ★ in card art — see the perk description on each character screen for the full rule.
settings.gameDataWarn: The deck engine is unit-tested but individual perk data may contain transcription errors. Please verify against the printed rulebook before relying on results in competitive play.
settings.creditsDesign: Game design: Isaac Childres / Cephalofair Games.
settings.creditsData: Perk data: Lurkars + community contributors to Gloomhaven Secretariat.
settings.creditsArt: Class portraits: © Isaac Childres / Cephalofair Games, used under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 via the Gloomhaven Creator Pack and Gloomhaven Secretariat.
settings.creditsApp: App: built with React Native + Expo.
settings.advantageSub: How rolling modifiers work when you draw with advantage or disadvantage.
settings.advAutoSub: Frosthaven classes use Frosthaven rules; all others use Gloomhaven rules.
settings.advFhSub: Draw past any rolling cards, then one more. Rolling cards add to whichever you pick; the second card's rolling icon is ignored.
settings.advGhSub: Draw two. A rolling card adds to the other one, so there's no choice; with disadvantage rolling cards are ignored.
settings.rollingHouseRule: House rule: keep rolling on the second card
settings.rollingHouseRuleSub: With Frosthaven rules, a rolling second card draws on to a non-rolling one instead of having its rolling icon ignored.

update.readyA11y: Update ready. Tap to restart the app and apply it.
